name: FFS_MESSAGE_STEP
description: Contains configured steps for notification scenarios.

columns.name: STEP_ID
columns.description: Link to the record in FFS_MESSAGE_STEP->STEP_ID.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Step type. (start - top step, inner - related step).

columns.name: FLOW_ID
columns.description: Link to the unique identifier of the notification scenario (ffs_message_flow->flow_id).

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Message Step Name. Unique text value.

columns.name: METHOD
columns.description: Identifier of message method which is used to process the message..

columns.name: SUBMETHOD
columns.description: Additional identifier for message method 'external_system'.

columns.name: FAULT_RETRIES
columns.description: Rest of attempts quantity on notification sent failure.

columns.name: FAULT_INTERVAL
columns.description: Interval before next notification attempt on notification sent failure.

columns.name: SENT_RETRIES
columns.description: Rest of attempts quantity on notification sent.

columns.name: SENT_INTERVAL
columns.description: Interval before next notification attempt on notification sent.

columns.name: DELAY
columns.description: Delay the message by specified minutes.

columns.name: RECIPIENT
columns.description: Recipient. Values: 'customer', 'provider', 'dispatcher', 'static'.

columns.name: TIME_IN_MSG
columns.description: Defines what time to use in message.

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: Notification Address which was used for the action.

columns.name: ADDRESS_PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Reference to the unique property ID -> FFS_PROPERTY_DESC -> PROPERTY_ID.

columns.name: STATIC_ADDRESS
columns.description: Recipient Address. Used to send the message to specific users, user groups, and helpdesks.

columns.name: STATIC_TIME_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the time zone created in the system.

columns.name: STATIC_LANGUAGE_ID
columns.description: F.k. language. language for static address.

columns.name: REPLY_TO
columns.description: The value for the 'reply to' email parameter, which is used as a senders address in an email notification.

columns.name: SKIP_HOLIDAYS
columns.description: Indicates whether the message sending should be postponed during a configured holiday date.`.

columns.name: MAX_DAYS_TO_SHIFT
columns.description: The number of days to shift proactive customer messages back in the calendar if messages are assigned for a day of the week for which a block is set or if they are assigned to fall on a company holiday when holidays are blocked.

columns.name: SKIP_WEEKDAYS
columns.description: The days of the week on which proactive customer messages should not be sent.

columns.name: SEND_AT
columns.description: The notification interval starts directly from the message creation.

columns.name: SEND_DAY_SHIFT
columns.description: It defines a number of days to add to the date determined using the 'method'.

columns.name: SEND_FROM
columns.description: Specifies starting time of the message time range for sending the message.

columns.name: SEND_WITHIN
columns.description: It is a length of the notification interval in hours/minutes. (end time = start time + length).

columns.name: SURVEY_ID
columns.description: This field is not used and can be removed.

columns.name: FEATURES
columns.description: It is a set of boolean flags that define behavior of this message step.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
